tunnels.name: Home tunnel (south)
tunnels.notes: Dug at y 121 from the Home portal, straight south until it opened into the cavern. Torches on the right going out.

tunnels.name: West tunnel (y 112)
tunnels.notes: Long straight E-W tunnel at y 112 along z -39. Torches at the far ends.

tunnels.name: Stairs down to y 100
tunnels.notes: Steps down from the y-112 tunnel to y 100 at the x -440 corner. A y-100 tunnel continues east.

tunnels.name: East tunnel (y 100)
tunnels.notes: Straight y-100 tunnel along z -40 from x -441 to -340 with torches; a skeleton wandered in once.

tunnels.name: Stairs up to y 121
tunnels.notes: Steps up from y 100 to y 121 at the x -318 end; the ceiling here is bedrock.

tunnels.name: Home link (y 121)
tunnels.notes: Short y-121 link to the Home portal's tunnel head at (-307, -31).

tunnels.name: Shaft down to the lava cavern
tunnels.notes: Stairs/shaft from y 121 at (-319,-40) down to y 63 at (-319, 22): opens onto a crimson forest with a lava pool. Careful.

tunnels.name: Low tunnel (y 47)
tunnels.notes: Deep y-47 tunnel heading west from (-303, 23) to the warped cavern at (-420, 15).
